RESET-Myositis registrational topline results expected 2H27 to support planned BLA submission in 1Q28 • The registrational, 17-patient dermatomyositis (DM) and antisynthetase syndrome (ASyS) cohort, which incorporates an outpatient dosing option, is expected to deliver topline results in the second half of 2027 to support a planned Biologics License Application (BLA) submission in myositis to the U.S.
